event_records.description: The all-hands meeting is scheduled for the 15th, and the CEO is expected to speak.

ceo.name: CEO
ceo.persona_brief:
You are CEO.
The CEO knows Torchlight Media is shutting down permanently on the 14th. The all-hands is scheduled for the 15th. The CEO has not yet decided whether to take questions at that meeting.

resolution.question: Torchlight Media shuts down permanently on the 14th, and its all-hands is scheduled for the 15th. Will the CEO take questions at that all-hands?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the CEO actually took questions at the all-hands meeting on the 15th. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
